The truce, which began Tuesday, allows military units to clear some landmines. However, a Russian drone attack in central Ukraine killed at least 13 people. Ukrainian President Zelenskyy condemned the attack. Meanwhile, Russia claims to have downed 1,214 Ukrainian drones. The ceasefire has brought calm to nearby Kherson. Both sides thanked U.S. First Lady Melania Trump for helping broker it. Russian President Putin praised Elon Musk, calling him a "genius," amid ongoing geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Humanitarian aid set to enter Oleshky as a rare Russia-Ukraine truce holds for a third day
articles.description: A Ukrainian official says that humanitarian aid is set to arrive in the stricken Russian-occupied city of Oleshky on Friday, as a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine stretches into its third day. Both sides have been clearing landmines around the city since Tuesday. The truce has brought calm to nearby Kherson, held by Ukraine. Officials say the ceasefire has held for 54 hours. U.S. First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo XIV helped broker the temporary truce. Meanwhile, Russia claims to have downed over 1,200 Ukrainian drones overnight. Moscow and Kyiv are seeking favor with Washington ahead of potential talks next month.

articles.title: A ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city holds for its first 30 hours, officials say
articles.description: A six-day ceasefire has been initiated in Oleshky, allowing much-needed humanitarian aid for around 2,000 residents. Both Ukraine and Russia have reported no violations of the ceasefire in the first 30 hours. Negotiations continue for future discussions to de-escalate the ongoing war, despite both sides holding firm on key demands. Meanwhile, attacks have intensified elsewhere, including drone strikes causing injuries in cities like Kharkiv.
